# Runbook: zero-downtime AKS node-pool upgrade to Kubernetes 1.30

**Audience:** platform SRE on-call · **Cluster:** `aks-cooleng-prod-eus2` (resource group `rg-cooleng-aks-prod`) · **Change window:** Tuesdays 14:00–17:00 UTC

## 1. Pre-checks (T-1 day)

```bash
az aks get-upgrades -g rg-cooleng-aks-prod -n aks-cooleng-prod-eus2 -o table
kubectl version            # client v1.30.x
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl get pdb -A         # every multi-replica workload must have a PDB with maxUnavailable >= 1
kubectl get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase!=Running,status.phase!=Succeeded
```

- Confirm no deprecated APIs are in use (review the AKS upgrade insights for the cluster, or `kubectl get --raw /metrics | grep apiserver_requested_deprecated_apis`).
- Confirm the etcd/cluster-state backup completed (Velero schedule `daily-cluster`, see answer A7).

## 2. Upgrade the control plane only

```bash
az aks upgrade -g rg-cooleng-aks-prod -n aks-cooleng-prod-eus2 \
  --kubernetes-version 1.30.x --control-plane-only --yes
```

## 3. Upgrade node pools with surge and drain limits

```bash
az aks nodepool update -g rg-cooleng-aks-prod --cluster-name aks-cooleng-prod-eus2 \
  -n userpool1 --max-surge 33% --drain-timeout 45
az aks nodepool upgrade -g rg-cooleng-aks-prod --cluster-name aks-cooleng-prod-eus2 \
  -n userpool1 --kubernetes-version 1.30.x --yes
```

Watch in a second terminal:

```bash
kubectl get nodes -L kubernetes.azure.com/agentpool -w
kubectl get events -A --field-selector reason=Evicted -w
```

## 4. Stuck drain

If a node stays `SchedulingDisabled` beyond the drain timeout, find the blocking PDB:

```bash
kubectl get pdb -A -o custom-columns=NS:.metadata.namespace,NAME:.metadata.name,ALLOWED:.status.disruptionsAllowed
```

Scale the owning workload up by one replica rather than deleting the PDB.

## 5. Rollback

AKS does not downgrade node pools. Roll back by creating a new node pool on the previous version, cordoning the upgraded pool and draining it (`kubectl cordon`, `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`).

## 6. Post-checks

`kubectl get nodes` shows v1.30.x everywhere; Grafana **Kubernetes / Cluster** dashboard error rate and p95 latency within 10% of the previous week.
